name: Flutterwave

auth.note: v4 replaces v3's static FLWSECK- Bearer key with OAuth client-credentials. Cache the 10-minute token per clientId, refresh ~60s before expiry, and re-auth once on a 401.

environments.note: The production base host is documented inconsistently (f4bexperience vs api.flutterwave.cloud/f4b/production) — make the live host configurable; sandbox host is fixed.

payment_method.card: payment_method.type='card', card:{ nonce, encrypted_card_number, encrypted_expiry_month, encrypted_expiry_year, encrypted_cvv } — AES-256-GCM field encryption
payment_method.mobile_money: payment_method.type='mobile_money', mobile_money:{ network, country_code, phone_number } — NO encryption

encryption.key: base64-decode the Encryption Key to 32 bytes (AES-256)
encryption.iv: the per-request 12-char nonce (its UTF-8 bytes), also echoed inside payment_method.card.nonce
encryption.note: Key encoding, IV=nonce, and tag-append are per-docs convention and UNCONFIRMED against an official SDK. Mobile money / bank transfer are NOT encrypted.

status.webhook_verification: v4: header 'flutterwave-signature' = base64(HMAC-SHA256(rawBody, secretHash)); compared constant-time over the RAW bytes. This REPLACES v3's plain 'verif-hash' equality check — the header name and scheme both changed.
status.requires_requery_note: GET /charges/{id} may return requires_requery — wait ~20s and re-GET; do NOT re-charge.

credentials_required.label: Client ID
credentials_required.note: v4 OAuth client id (Settings → API Keys). Distinct from the legacy FLWSECK- v3 key.

credentials_required.label: Client Secret
credentials_required.note: v4 OAuth client secret; exchanged for a 10-minute Bearer token at the IdP token endpoint.

credentials_required.label: Encryption Key
credentials_required.note: base64 → 32-byte AES-256 key used for direct card-field encryption (not needed for mobile money / bank).

credentials_required.label: Webhook Secret Hash
credentials_required.note: Settings → Webhooks; HMAC-SHA256 key that verifies the 'flutterwave-signature' header.

sandbox.card_scenarios: scenario:<v>&issuer:<v> (scenario: auth_pin, auth_pin_3ds, auth_3ds, auth_avs, auth_redirect; issuer: approved, insufficient_funds, incorrect_pin, expired_card, suspected_fraud, system_error)
sandbox.notes: v4 outcomes are scenario-driven via X-Scenario-Key rather than fixed test PANs. Omit the header → card defaults to noauth.

pain_points.problem: v3 integration breaks after migrating to v4
pain_points.cause: v4 changes auth (OAuth vs static FLWSECK- key), the initiate endpoint (/orchestration/direct-charges vs /v3/payments), card encryption (AES-256-GCM fields vs none), and the webhook header (flutterwave-signature HMAC vs plain verif-hash)
pain_points.mitigation: Treat the API version as a hard config boundary; do not port v3 code path-by-path — rebuild against the v4 orchestration + OAuth + HMAC scheme

pain_points.cause: v4 client-credentials tokens live only ~10 minutes
pain_points.mitigation: Cache the token per clientId, refresh ~60s before expiry, and re-auth once on a 401 before failing

pain_points.cause: Wrong AES-256-GCM setup — key not base64-decoded to 32 bytes, IV not the 12-char nonce, or the GCM tag placed wrongly
pain_points.mitigation: base64-decode the Encryption Key to 32 bytes, use the 12-char nonce as the IV (echoed in card.nonce), and append the 16-byte tag to the ciphertext before base64; verify against an official SDK

pain_points.problem: Webhook signature check fails after upgrade
pain_points.cause: Still comparing v3's plain 'verif-hash' header; v4 sends 'flutterwave-signature' = base64(HMAC-SHA256(rawBody, secretHash))
pain_points.mitigation: Verify the new header as an HMAC over the RAW body bytes with constant-time compare; never re-serialise the JSON before hashing

pain_points.problem: Marking an order paid on the redirect return or an unverified webhook
pain_points.cause: next_action.redirect_url and inbound webhooks can be spoofed or replayed
pain_points.mitigation: Always reconcile via GET /charges/{id} and confirm data.status === succeeded before fulfilling; handle requires_requery by waiting ~20s and re-querying (never re-charge)

pain_points.cause: A reset connection re-POSTs the same charge
pain_points.mitigation: Send a UUID X-Idempotency-Key on every POST; Flutterwave returns X-Idempotency-Cache-Hit on a replay

notes: Zimbabwe is NOT a supported Flutterwave merchant/settlement country — a ZW business cannot onboard for local settlement. Flutterwave is only useful to ManishaPay for regional/USD/diaspora collections (NG, GH, KE, ZA, etc.); route Zimbabwe-local payments to PayNow. Built on the CURRENT default v4 API (OAuth client-credentials, orchestration direct-charges, AES-256-GCM card encryption, HMAC 'flutterwave-signature' webhook).

verification.verified_notes: v4 OAuth token + mobile-money orchestrator direct-charge verified live against the sandbox (real chg_ id + hosted redirect). Reference must be alphanumeric; customer.phone must be an object {country_code, number}.
unverified_fields: card AES-256-GCM path (only mobile-money charge tested live; verify card encryption vs official SDK)
